description: Watergang Vaart is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opengeodata.zeeland.nl. watercourse, usually dug, for drainage and/or shipping. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
